items.title: Roger Kellaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999

ctx.x: Yeah. He came before Don Rickles. He was such a sensitive guy, it was amazing. He asked me what time it was one night at the Copacabana, and I said, “I don’t know, I don’t have a watch.” And the next day there was an Henri Gireaux watch and he was so sensitive. I never really got this, the desire for the perhaps father-son relationship because I was kind of young at the time I was doing this. But I adored him. He’s one of the great people in my life because he was out of vaudeville and the vaudeville people have…
You’ve got to learn the power of understatement too.
